entries.text: Cinema recommendations (dev admin) — a RECOMMENDED tab surfacing titles that are on none of the lists yet, drawn from new releases, your favourites and watch history, acclaimed older films, and your most-watched genres, with one-click add to watchlist and a not-interested list

Cinema franchise gaps — the same tab suggests films missing from collections already part-watched, with the Marvel and DC shared universes enumerated by keyword since neither exists as a TMDB collection
Cinema watchlist — a FINISHING filter for queued films that would carry a franchise you have started further along, grouped by franchise with progress in each heading
Steam review reader — opening a review shows cover art, the verdict, hours on record, the full write-up, the score and the pros and cons
Steam Library reviews are a grid of cover art with the verdict on every card, replacing the list of expanding rows

Patch notes renumbered so the version reflects the size of a release — new pages, tabs and systems move the middle number, content and fixes the last. The two Games releases are merged into one, and the per-game entries no longer list every individual stat
Tabletop covers sit in a square frame, so the mostly-square box art fills the card instead of leaving a strip of empty space above and below
Main menu — Side Projects is now Projects
Battlefield 4 kits were laid out as one non-wrapping row roughly 900px wide: four of the five were off-screen and unreachable on a phone, and the last was cut off in the desktop split view
Cinema filter bar left a tall empty gap under the search box on phones — the block kept a 300px flex basis that became a height once the bar stacked
Journey map never applied its zoom and pan limits; the call that set them threw, which also skipped the fit-to-pins that followed it
Steam review for Webbed showed another game’s artwork — the stored app id was one digit out and pointed at a different title
Games page (DLCS // DOWNLOAD 03) — a tabbed home for per-game stat pages, covering seven games
Battlefield 4 service record — a rank dossier, career grid, kits with service stars, and weapons and vehicles behind category filters
Battlefield 4 assignments — all 108 tracked with badge art, per-task progress, rewards and unlock prerequisites, tagged by paid expansion with the DLC badge art
Counter-Strike 2 career stats — headline tiles, a service record, weapons ranked by kills, maps as win-rate bars, and objective counters
RuneScape profile — skills with virtual levels and XP progress, quest completion broken down by difficulty, and the recent adventurer’s log
Team Fortress 2 career record — all nine classes ranked by kills, a career grid, the class specialities, and Mann vs Machine totals
PAYDAY 2 CRIME.NET record — heist completion and offshore balance, weapons ranked by kills, enemy types, and the spread across difficulty tiers
Satisfactory pioneer record — belt, foundation, pipeline and railway totals, milestones broken down by tier, alternate recipes, and the FICSIT anomalies
Deep Rock Galactic mission log — missions and milestones, weakspots, dreadnaughts and lootbugs, hazard no-fail streaks, and the Rock and Stone counters

Build-time sync scripts and GitHub workflows for all seven games, staggered through Monday morning so they never contend for the Steam API key, plus a shared helper module the scripts read Steam through
RuneScape quest log enriched from the RuneScape Wiki, with a local cache so repeat syncs only fetch titles it has not seen, plus free-to-play and members icons

Counter-Strike 2 map icons — each map borrows its weapon collection’s emblem, which covers retired maps like Cobblestone and St. Marc that the game’s shipped set icons leave blank; 20 of the 21 tracked maps resolve
Steam written review: Inked: A Tale of Love
Games page — seven tabs now come from a single registry and load on demand, so opening it no longer downloads every game’s stats at once

Battlefield 4, Counter-Strike 2 and RuneScape share one game-page toolkit — the container-width layout hook, number formatting, filter chips, stat rows and record grids live in one place instead of a copy per page
Steam tier list — nine more games placed
Dev admin — the RuneScape character panel (display name, tagline, note, and image override) is editable in place, and the sync preserves those edits

Small caption text under every figure was drawn in a colour barely above its background (about 2:1 against a 4.5:1 readable floor) at 8px — the labels now use the supporting text colour and a larger size across all seven game pages, and the tab bar and active filter chips were corrected the same way
Record grids whose last row did not fill the width showed a bare block of the panel’s gap colour where the missing cells were
Main menu no longer scrolls independently of the page beside it — the split view had two nested scrollbars, and reaching the end of the inner one carried on scrolling the outer one past the content
Journey page — on wide screens the world map and trip log sit side by side, with the map sticky and sized to the viewport so pins stay visible while scrolling the log; narrow layouts still stack
Dev admin — delete now uses an in-page confirm dialog instead of the browser prompt, and items are re-located by id before removal so a stale index can never delete the wrong row
Dev admin — expired sessions after a dev server restart report a clear message instead of a generic save failure; item controls can hide reorder arrows on views with their own sort order
Steam written reviews: Grapple Dog, Cozy Cleaner, and Henry Halfhead
QA Portfolio — another undisclosed Gameround playtest under NDA
Cinema page (EXTRA // SCREENING ROOM) — movies and shows tracked as watched, watching, dropped, or watchlisted, with favorites, ratings, season and episode counts, and per-show progress
TMDB title search in the admin editor — picking a result autofills title, year, poster, seasons, episodes, runtime, genres, and overview, so entries no longer need to be typed by hand
Cinema overview tab — title, movie, show, episode, completion, drop, and average-rating stats plus a highest-rated list
Steam library filter bar accepts a custom search placeholder so the control can be reused across pages
Steam Library HowLongToBeat times — completionist (100%) estimates baked into library data, shown in the game detail drawer with your hours vs the HLTB estimate and a link to the HLTB page
Library sort options — HLTB 100% (Longest) and HLTB 100% (Shortest) for finding marathon or quick completionist picks
HLTB fetch pipeline — cached HowLongToBeat enrichment in the Steam sync script (base games only, DLC rejected) with incremental checkpoints
Steam Library detail panel — column count measurement no longer leaves a gap beside the selected cover when expanding a game
Steam written review: Desktop Golf

Visitor achievements — 34 medals track exploration, sessions, and site interactions; unlock toasts, achievements drawer, menu entry, Settings shortcut, and platinum BUILD VERIFIED title when every medal is earned
Resume CV download — editable PDF link on the Resume page with CMS and local admin support, including file upload to public/uploads
QA Portfolio playtests — Official and Gameround sections with cover art, Steam links, NDA-safe undisclosed entries, and a Games Worked On block (PAYDAY 3)
PlaytestCover component — custom cover URL with Steam art fallback for portfolio playtest tiles
Admin file upload API — dev server endpoint for PDF and image uploads used by the CV field and content editor
Admin content editor — paste, Ctrl+V, and PASTE URL now work reliably in personal info and other text fields (Chromium clipboard and backdrop-filter issues)
Admin editor isolation — modal renders outside filtered app layers; menu keyboard shortcuts pause while editing
QA Portfolio layout — responsive playtest grid with subsection headers and improved tile styling
Resume download button — activates when a CV URL is set; shows disabled state until configured
Tabletop page — board games shelf with owned, featured, and wishlist filters, win/loss record stats, BGG links, and cover art
Tabletop CMS support — editable via local admin and Decap CMS
Main menu availability badge — CMS-editable hiring status under BUILD VERIFIED with pulsing status dot, optional custom label and note, and matching row in System Telemetry on the desktop home screen
Library shelf — Play Nice, Press Reset, and Minecraft added to the codex
Steam written review: Viewfinder
Hall of Pain — Hollow Knight, Hotline Miami 2, Noita, Dark Souls, and additional dreading titles added to the wall
Steam Achievements browse list — game picker now sorted alphabetically instead of by unlock count
Steam tier list — Shredders moved from Unplayed to C tier
Music page — LIVE SHOWS section logs attended performances with date, venue, city, optional Tour / Festival badge, Spotify listen links, and auto-resolved artist cover art
Music performances CMS support — editable via local admin and Decap CMS
Journey trip log — trips grouped by year with animated expand/collapse and scroll-to-selected when picking a map pin
Journey map — Prague, Kufstein, Brač, Billund, Berlin, and Bigova trips added; Ko Lanta period updated
Steam written review: Duncrush
Music menu description updated to mention live shows
Library page — book shelf with READ and favorite badges, favorites sorted first, and CMS support via local admin and Decap CMS
Steam written reviews: Gamble With Your Friends and Gold Miner: Classic Edition
EXTRA menu — Library and Journey added; Livestream moved to the bottom; Media and Music subtitles updated (EXTRA // REPLAY VAULT, EXTRA // ON REPEAT)
Dev admin — content editor modal renders via portal above page UI; travel location picker with geocode search for Journey pins
Journey map — zoom and pan clamped so tiles fill the frame with horizontal wrap; no trip or home highlight on first visit
Journey page — interactive dark world map with trip pins, selectable trip cards, highlights, photo lightbox, and embedded YouTube travel videos; seeded with Thailand and Midsummer trips
Journey CMS support — editable home base and trips (lat/lng, photos, highlights) via local admin and Decap CMS

Livestream page expansion — about blurb, Follow on Twitch CTA, collapsible mobile chat, stream highlights gallery (YouTube, Twitch clips, and Twitch videos) with auto-fetched thumbnails, stream loadout, and chat rules/commands sections
Livestream: flexible “When I Stream” note replaces the fixed weekly schedule; optional schedule slots still supported via CMS if you add them later
Music page — favorite albums and artists with Spotify listen links and auto-resolved cover art when no custom image is set
Steam Library: client-side library capsule art lookup (SteamCMD product info) for sharper grid covers, with legacy CDN fallbacks
Steam written review: Fingerdance
Hall of Pain and tier list data updates
Steam Milestones tab — refreshed milestone cards, progress styling, and next-up highlighting
Steam fetch script extended for additional library metadata used by cover art and milestones
Decap CMS and dev admin schemas updated for livestream, music, and related content fields

Steam Library: Hall of Pain tab — a curated wall of framed brutal games with status badges (Conquered, Broke Me, Still Bleeding, Dreading It), optional notes, and a gallery-style presentation with gunmetal frames and gilded gold for conquered titles
Hall of Pain: games with 100% achievements are automatically shown as Conquered; incomplete entries render in grayscale until conquered; dev admin can add, edit, reorder, and remove entries
Steam written review: V Rising

Steam Library: Overview tab (new default) — a consolidated dashboard with profile stats, most-played chart, achievement completion, rarity distribution, and a full-year unlock-activity calendar where days are clickable for details and perfected-game days are highlighted in gold, plus at-a-glance Reviews, Wishlist, and Tier List summaries

Steam Library: Achievements tab with per-achievement detail (icons, descriptions, unlock dates, and global rarity); Showcase surfaces rarest and most recent unlocks and perfect games, and Browse explores any game's achievements sorted by rarity, unlock date, or locked state
Steam written reviews: search and pagination, with each review collapsed to a summary card that expands for the full write-up, pros, and cons
Steam fetch script now stores full per-achievement data (schema and global rarity) for every game with at least one unlock
Steam Library: the Library tab is now a clean game grid — profile and stats moved into the new Overview tab
Media gallery: Midsummer – 2026 video entry
Steam written reviews: Mind Over Magnet and LEGO Jurassic World added

Steam Library: Milestones tab with tier tracks for library size, lifetime playtime, deepest single title, flawless runs, achievement haul, and wishlist; three-column milestone cards with completed checkmarks, progress bars, and compact captions
Tech Loadout: expanded page layout and styles; Content Editor, schemas, and EditableSection updated for richer items and admin saves
QA portfolio playtests, Steam reviews and tier list, and tech inventory data refreshed
QA portfolio playtests: optional store or page URL (e.g. Steam); linked game titles on the page when a URL is set; field in dev admin and Decap CMS
Tech Loadout: component inventory category with quantity and notes, hardware tag checkboxes for builds and inventory rows, and matching grid layout styling
Content editor and tech schemas refactored for per-category item fields and nested editors
Comms panel and contact card landing layout polish
Portfolio, resume, Steam reviews and tier list, and tech data updated
Steam tier list (dev admin): drag-and-drop to reorder games within a tier or move them between tiers; changes persist to steam-tierlist.json
EditableSection: fires admin-collection-saved after save, delete, and reorder so linked views (e.g. tier list) refresh without a reload
Steam tier thumbnails use SteamGameCover with a text-only fallback path for cleaner tiles when library art fails
QA portfolio playtests, Steam written reviews, and tier list data updated
Dev admin: removing a tag row in the tech item editor (red X) works reliably; list fields are no longer wrapped in a label that intercepted the control
QA Portfolio: removed the empty Certificates block and simplified portfolio data; main menu descriptions updated
Tech Loadout: richer category sections in tech data (platforms, testing, game engines, and more); duplicate standalone skills block removed from the page and CMS
Steam library: game cover component, expanded written reviews, and updates to wishlist, filters, and the Steam fetch script
Resume, Steam tier list, and related JSON content refreshed
Credits: rolling text starts just below the visible credits area at any window size, and scroll speed stays steady across different display refresh rates
Credits: faster crawl speed for the acknowledgments
Media gallery: YouTube links in Video URL open as an embedded player in the lightbox; optional auto thumbnail when no image URL is set
Media gallery: in dev admin mode, per-item edit / reorder / delete controls work again (gallery tiles are no longer nested buttons)
Steam library written reviews and media gallery entries updated
Public launch — portfolio, contact card, and gaming-themed shell are live
QA portfolio, downloadable resume, side projects, tech loadout, and media gallery
Steam library with owned games, stats, written reviews, tier list, and wishlist tabs
Livestream page (Twitch), scrolling credits, and this patch notes changelog
Settings for palette, CRT overlay, scanlines, color-vision filters, motion, and UI sounds
Main menu status panel with connection readout and latest-patch preview
Desktop split layout at 1200px+ with menu and content side by side; standard routing on smaller viewports
Dedicated patch notes page backed by editable JSON
Status panel telemetry (browser, OS, connection) and patch detail modal
Page shell layout and navigation polish across story chapters
Focus and transition glitches when moving between menu and routes
Settings screen for appearance, accessibility, and audio
Optional sound effects on menu navigation and actions
Menu keyboard focus sticking after navigating to a page and back
Credits page with auto-scroll through acknowledgments
Livestream route with embedded Twitch player
Keyboard navigation and roving tabindex across main menu items
Boot sequence replaying on every return to home; now skipped after first completion (session)
Desktop split-view shell when the viewport is 1200px or wider
Steam integration: library JSON, filters, sorting, pagination, and game detail drawer
Navigation structure reworked for keyboard and screen-reader use
Responsive layout breakpoints on tablet-sized widths
QA portfolio timeline and project entries
Resume page with structured data and CV download
Side projects section
Color palette, typography scale, and component styling pass
Site rebuilt with React, Vite, and React Router
Boot sequence intro and main menu with animated particle background
Overall direction: retro terminal / game launcher presentation
